_readme: Boss Guide settings + notes. includeRegularTrainers: false = only boss classes (tools/export_trainers.py BOSS_CLASSES) go into the calc. Per trainer (key = trainer id from trainers.json / the #number in trainers_showdown.txt): label = calc set name (default 'Name #id'), title = big header (default 'Class Name'), hide = true to leave out, notes = text under the team, mons = {"Species": "note under that card"}. itemSummaries: short line shown under an item (hover shows the full game text).

itemSummaries.Quick Claw: Always moves first once, then breaks
